# Metric definitions

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every number on the dashboard comes from an API response, and every API number from one of the definitions below. The dashboard formats values (digit grouping, currency sign) but never computes them. The same SQL compiler (`src/reporting/sql.ts`) serves metrics, extracts and dataset checks, so they cannot disagree about a definition. Scenario J and `test/e2e/dashboard.test.ts` verify dashboard, API, extract and independent SQL agree.

## How tenant-declared metrics are computed

- **Source**: the entity's current canonical versions (`_is_current`) joined to `core.batches`.
- **Trust scope**: `value` counts only batches with `trust_status = trusted`. `value_including_untrusted` counts all processed batches; `untrusted_records_excluded` is the number of current records held back; `trusted = true` only when nothing was held back.
- **Filters**: the metric's declared condition, compiled to SQL with three-valued logic (a null never satisfies a comparison).
- **Aggregation**: `count`, `count_distinct(field)`, `sum(field)` rounded to the field's scale, `avg(field)` rounded to 4 places. Decimal sums are exact (PostgreSQL numeric).
- **Refresh**: computed at query time from committed data. A batch's effects become visible atomically when its transaction commits.

## northwind (contract 1.0.0)

| Metric | Definition | Entity | Aggregation | Filter | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Active members** `active_members` | Members whose current eligibility status is ACTIVE. | member | count | `{"field":"status","op":"eq","value":"ACTIVE"}` | count |
| **Members on file** `members_total` | Members with a current eligibility record in any status. | member | count | `none` | count |
| **Claims** `claims_total` | Distinct claims (current adjudication) in any status. | claim | count | `none` | count |
| **Paid claims** `paid_claims` | Claims whose current adjudication status is PAID. | claim | count | `{"field":"status","op":"eq","value":"PAID"}` | count |
| **Denied claims** `denied_claims` | Claims whose current adjudication status is DENIED. | claim | count | `{"field":"status","op":"eq","value":"DENIED"}` | count |
| **Total paid (medical)** `total_paid` | Sum of paid_amount over current claim versions with status PAID or REVERSED. | claim | sum(paid_amount) | `{"field":"status","op":"in","values":["PAID","REVERSED"]}` | usd |
| **Total billed (medical)** `total_billed` | Sum of billed_amount over all current claim versions. | claim | sum(billed_amount) | `none` | usd |
| **Pharmacy fills** `rx_fills` | Current pharmacy fills with status FILLED. | pharmacy_fill | count | `{"field":"status","op":"eq","value":"FILLED"}` | count |
| **Pharmacy plan paid** `rx_plan_paid` | Sum of plan_paid over current FILLED pharmacy fills. | pharmacy_fill | sum(plan_paid) | `{"field":"status","op":"eq","value":"FILLED"}` | usd |

## bluefin (contract 1.0.0)

| Metric | Definition | Entity | Aggregation | Filter | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Active enrollees** `active_enrollees` | Enrollees with no termination date on their current record. | enrollee | count | `{"field":"terminated_on","op":"is_null"}` | count |
| **Approved Rx claims** `approved_rx_claims` | Current Rx claims in APPROVED state. | rx_claim | count | `{"field":"claim_state","op":"eq","value":"APPROVED"}` | count |
| **Plan cost (approved)** `plan_cost_total` | Sum of plan_cost over current APPROVED Rx claims. | rx_claim | sum(plan_cost) | `{"field":"claim_state","op":"eq","value":"APPROVED"}` | usd |
| **Average copay** `avg_copay` | Mean copay over current APPROVED Rx claims. | rx_claim | avg(copay) | `{"field":"claim_state","op":"eq","value":"APPROVED"}` | usd |
| **Utilizing enrollees** `utilizing_enrollees` | Distinct enrollees with at least one current APPROVED Rx claim. | rx_claim | count_distinct(enrollee_id) | `{"field":"claim_state","op":"eq","value":"APPROVED"}` | count |

## Platform operational metrics

| Metric | Definition | Source | Filters | Aggregation | Refresh |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `batches` | Batches registered in the window (including rejected). | core.batches | tenant_id, arrival_at in [from, to] | count(*) | live query |
| `succeeded` | Batches whose processing committed (completed or completed_with_exceptions). Says nothing about trust. | core.batches | status IN ('completed','completed_with_exceptions') | count(*) | live query |
| `trusted` | Batches that completed AND passed every reconciliation check AND stayed under the reject-rate threshold. | core.batches | trust_status = 'trusted' | count(*) | set when the batch commits |
| `untrusted` | Batches excluded from trusted outputs (reconciliation failure, reject rate above threshold, structural rejection or processing failure). | core.batches | trust_status = 'untrusted' | count(*) | set when the batch commits or fails |
| `rows_received` | Rows staged from submitted payloads (one per CSV data line or JSON record). | core.batches.received_count | window | sum | set at submission |
| `rows_accepted` | Canonical record versions written (current or historical/late). Exact duplicates excluded. | core.batches.accepted_count | window | sum | set when the batch commits |
| `rows_quarantined` | Rows held out of canonical data for structural, business-rule, referential, privacy or conflict errors. | core.batches.quarantined_count | window | sum | set when the batch commits |
| `exception_rate` | rows_quarantined / rows_received across processed batches (all time). | core.batches | status IN ('completed','completed_with_exceptions') | sum(quarantined_count) / sum(received_count) | live query |
| `duplicate_submissions` | Submissions whose payload digest matched an existing batch (no business effect). | core.batch_submissions | outcome = 'duplicate', submitted_at in window | count(*) | live query |
| `latency_p50_s / latency_p95_s` | Arrival-to-completion seconds for processed batches. | core.batches | completed_at IS NOT NULL, not rejected, window | percentile_cont(0.5 / 0.95) | live query |
| `freshness.age_hours` | Hours since the most recent TRUSTED batch for the source completed. Stale when above the entity freshness.max_age_hours. | core.batches | source_id, trust_status = 'trusted' | now() - max(completed_at) | live query |
| `queue.queued / queue.oldest_queued_age_s` | Backlog depth and age of the oldest waiting batch. | core.batches | status = 'queued' | count / now() - min(arrival_at) | live query |

## Prometheus metrics (`/metrics`)

| Name | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| clearline_http_requests_total | counter | Requests by method, route, status |
| clearline_http_request_duration_seconds | histogram | Request latency by route |
| clearline_batches_submitted_total | counter | Submissions by tenant and outcome (accepted, duplicate, rejected) |
| clearline_batches_processed_total | counter | Processing attempts by tenant, status and trust |
| clearline_rows_processed_total | counter | Rows by tenant and disposition |
| clearline_batch_processing_seconds | histogram | Claim-to-commit processing time |
| clearline_authorization_denials_total | counter | Denials by reason (invalid_token, missing_permission, cross_tenant) |
| clearline_backlog_batches | gauge | Queued and processing batches per tenant |
| clearline_oldest_queued_seconds | gauge | Age of the oldest queued batch |
| clearline_data_freshness_seconds | gauge | Seconds since the last trusted batch per source |
| clearline_batches | gauge | All-time batches by pipeline status and trust |
| clearline_workers_live | gauge | Workers with a heartbeat in the last 60 s |

Counters and histograms are per process (API and each worker expose their own when scraped); gauges are computed from the database at scrape time and are therefore identical on every instance.
